case: STRICT ANY metadata for attached-schema query origins
change: Resolve SQLx's flattened attached table origin against SQLite's database list and schema-qualified table-valued PRAGMA metadata; retain fallback when multiple schemas match the flattened origin.
contract: A direct query of aux.flexible recovers declared ANY when its flattened origin uniquely identifies the attached table.
When main contains a table literally named aux.flexible, attached and main origins are ambiguous and remain at the original unknown metadata instead of being assigned a guessed declaration.
Query rows still preserve their actual runtime values in both ambiguous cases.
independent_oracle: SQLite STRICT declarations from the test setup plus exact query values from attached and main tables, including INTEGER versus TEXT runtime storage classes.
